newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 12 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 12 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insuarance the following 12 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Schaumburg Township, Ill., $8.1 million library general obligation bonds.
--New Orleans, La., $30 million sewage service revenue bonds.
--Dighton Regional School District, Mass., $3.8 million GOs.
--Bay De Noc Comm. College, Mich., $2.6 million building and site GOs is a direct purchase.
--Hempstead Village, N.Y., $5.410 million various purpose bonds and $3.344 million various purpose bonds.
--Naples CSD, N.Y., $5.4 million school district GOs.
--Snohomish County, Wash., $1.310 million limited tax bonds and $39.185 million limited tax bonds.
